mechanism: Valproic acid may increase tretinoin levels through CYP450 enzyme inhibition and protein binding displacement, while tretinoin is a known teratogen with potential for additive CNS effects.
action: Monitor for tretinoin toxicity signs (headache, visual changes, pseudotumor cerebri); avoid concurrent use in pregnancy; consider alternative retinoid or valproate if possible; ensure adequate contraception if used together in females of childbearing age.
